title: Thai Corn Fritters
description: Crispy and sweet Thai corn fritters made with a hint of zesty flavor. Perfect as a snack or appetizer.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine corn, yeast, and 1 cup of warm water. Let it sit for 10 minutes, or until foamy.
2. Add zesty breading and mix well.
3. Heat 2 cups of vegetable oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
4. Using a spoon, drop small balls of the corn mixture into the hot oil.
5. Fry the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
6. Remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel to drain excess oil.
7. Sprinkle with salt and sugar to taste.
